answer: Tint every task input. Each agent receives job data carrying its own invisible pigment, a unique marker woven into wording and numbers. If agent B's output ever carries the marker sent only to agent A, that is a thread tying both heads to one controller, so the ledger merges them and they share one reward and one vote. Farms reuse context to stay cheap, and every reuse leaks color. Honest agents lose nothing, since their work holds only their own tint, while a farm's pearl of standing splits with each leak.
